propositions: Child-enumeration and per-child-fetch failures in _assemble_context_uncached are caught by broad except Exception and silently continue with empty/partial children list, causing has_children to flip to False and container-scoped DET checks (p5_task_dag, p8_reviewability) to return trivial pass instead of incompleteness signal.

A container whose hierarchy failed to load can reach unqualified clean PASS verdict, violating parent epic 6eca-183e-1cd2-4fb9 AC #4 requirement that plan review cannot produce ordinary clean pass when ticket hierarchy was loaded incompletely unless omitted context is demonstrably irrelevant.

PlanContext must gain hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail fields, and context-assembly failures must set these flags and retry (2 attempts, 50ms delay) before flagging incompleteness.

hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail must be threaded through coverage dict at all five finalize_verdict call sites (plan_review_precheck, plan_review_coach, _recover_plan_review_coach_failure, _recover_plan_review_verify_failure, _degraded_plan_review_verdict) to properly propagate the flag.

finalize_verdict and drift_floor._recompute_verdict_after_drop must treat hierarchy_incomplete as INDETERMINATE trigger (same priority as llm_unavailable and verify_failed), and plan-review.yaml must pass hierarchy_incomplete/hierarchy_incomplete_detail to all four plan_review_coach steps via with block.

Relevance-exception carve-out must not be implemented because failed enumeration collapses children to empty list, which suppresses container-scoped criteria (p5_task_dag, p8_reviewability) unconditionally, making the trigger condition for a relevance exception unstatable.
